name: Darkmoon Prize Ticket
description: Awarded for winning games or doing favors at the Darkmoon Faire.

name: Honor Points
description: Honor is gained by killing members of the opposite faction in PvP combat. You can use honor points to purchase special items.

name: Merchant's Favor
description: Worth a considerable amount of gold and thus used as an interim currency among high-traffic merchant organizations. Members of the Durotar Supply and Logistics or Azeroth Commerce Authority would be willing to trade for this.

name: Rank Points
description: Rank points are gained by completing tasks given in Gadgetzan or participating in battlegrounds. Rank points increase your PvP Rank which grants you access to purchase special items.

name: Tarnished Undermine Real
description: This currency is slowly being phased out of circulation, but it still enjoys a very favorable exchange rate at goblin towns throughout the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.
